identity_boundary: A caret confirms canonical identity only. It does not transfer authorship, participation, receipt, knowledge, intention, coordination, correctness, wrongdoing, liability or outcome to another date, act, office or proceeding.

completion_rule: A task closes only when the identified primary source is controlled, its exact person/act/date/capacity is reconciled to CAEPR, the canonical missing-evidence item is updated, bilingual public surfaces are corrected where material and the specialist validator passes. Obtaining one task does not close another.
authority_boundary: This queue authorises no filing, service, email, request or third-party contact. Each external act requires separate current authority.
